source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only; no live execution has ever reached the poll loop (see hand-poll-completed.json).
source.rationale: Second time round the loop, job still pending. The point of this case is `_poll_n`: it is derived from THIS node's own $runIndex (0-based, so the second poll is runIndex 1 -> _poll_n 2), NOT from prev.poll_n, which is exactly what stops a stale $('media-route').first() read from resetting the counter and looping forever. media-route's MAX_POLLS is 2, so this output is the one that ends the loop with 'pending_exhausted'. `notices: null` in the job body must normalise to [] (the Array.isArray guard), because media-route does .filter() on it unconditionally.
